model.title: Taxpayer Advocate Participation Act
model.meta: Ways and Means Committee · Rep. W. Steube (R-FL)

summary.text: The bill would authorize the National Taxpayer Advocate—an independent office within the IRS that helps taxpayers resolve disputes—to submit legal briefs to federal courts in tax cases that could broadly affect taxpayers' rights. It would require federal courts to allow these submissions, giving the Advocate a voice in cases where taxpayer interests are at stake.
